Congratulations!

Joy Mayanne Barcoma of Bacoor City was crowned Miss Philippines Earth 2025 during the pageant’s 25th coronation night held at Okada Manila in Parañaque City on Sunday, 10 August 2025.

Maria Flordeliz Mabao of Antipolo City won the Miss Philippines Air title, while Jaymie Strickland, representing the Filipino community in Tallahassee, Florida, was named Miss Philippines Fire. Miss Philippines Water went to Angel Rose Tambal of La Paz, Leyte, and Kriezl Jane Torres of Talakag, Bukidnon, was crowned Miss Philippines Ecotourism.

#MissPhilippinesEarth2025 #dailytribune25
